outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot; no significance symbols are present.
Panel B is a histology micrograph, not a plot; no significance symbols are present.

The box plot in panel C shows * and *** above several genotype groups, and the caption explicitly defines these: '*P<0.05; ***P<0.001.' The definitions are stated directly in the text describing panel C, so the reader can interpret the symbols.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival plot with no significance symbols (asterisks, letters, etc.) shown on the plot or referenced in the caption for this panel.
The bar graph in panel E (GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 quantification) shows only mean bars with error bars and no significance symbols, so there is nothing to define.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot; no significance symbols are present.

The 'Relative expression' bar chart in panel G shows brackets marked with '*' comparing Asef, pJNK1 and MMP9 levels between genotypes/tissue types, but neither the panel G text nor any general figure-wide statement defines this significance level. The only significance definition in the caption ('*P<0.05; ***P<0.001') is given specifically within the description of panel C's polyp-number/size comparisons, so it is not clearly established that the same threshold applies to the distinct comparisons quantified in panel G.
